facts.fact: UNDP Sierra Leone's annual report says the Judiciary's mobile Justice App, launched in 2020 as a court case management system for the lower courts, has been used to dispose of 3,670 cases and automates case management, document management and scheduling.

SLE.note: Online filing and public access are stated as future aims only, so no fact is recorded for them.
